# Catalog

The vocabulary of the domain, declared in `lib/crisis_map/catalog.ex`. The
Ecto changeset, the LiveView filter, the map colours, the API and this page
all read it from there; none of them keeps a copy.

## Event types

| Id | Label | Colour | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `traffic_accident` | Dopravní nehoda | `#dc2626` | Road traffic collision. |
| `fire` | Požár | `#ea580c` | Fire of any object or vegetation. |
| `flood` | Povodeň / zaplavení | `#2563eb` | Flooding, flash flood, water damage. |
| `hazmat` | Nebezpečná látka | `#7c3aed` | Leak or presence of a hazardous substance. |
| `technical_rescue` | Technická pomoc | `#0d9488` | Technical assistance and rescue work. |
| `other` | Jiná událost | `#64748b` | Anything the source did not classify. Also the fallback for an unknown input type. |

A source type that is not in this list is filed under
`other` rather than rejected: losing an event
because a source invented a label would be worse than filing it as other.

## Geocoding statuses

Every state a position can be in. The schema enforces the pairing between a
status and the presence of coordinates, so "we know where this is" and "we
have no coordinates" can never both be true of one row.

| Id | Coordinates known | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `pending` | no | The record was stored but geocoding has not been attempted yet. |
| `ok` | yes | The geocoder returned a position for the location text. |
| `not_found` | no | The geocoder ran and returned no candidate for the location text. |
| `skipped` | no | There was no location text to geocode. |
| `error` | no | The geocoder was unreachable or answered with an error. Retryable. |
